plan.change: Removed the NEW pill and its styles.
Removed the '02 · PLAN' eyebrow and the all-caps 'INTELLIGENT · AUTONOMOUS · SAFE' subtitle.
Removed the <em> italics from the headline and dropped Instrument Serif.
Mono now appears only in the file-path block; the eyebrow that used mono is gone.
Removed the decorative → arrows from the action labels and the ← from the path line.
Replaced 'Plans first. Acts second.' with 'See the plan before any file changes' and cut the body copy to the edit/reorder/reject facts without powerful/AI-driven/seamlessly/empowering.
Turned the breadcrumb into a code block showing the real files the plan touches.
Made 'Get started' the one solid accent button and turned 'Learn more' into a quiet underlined link.
Gave the heading text-wrap: balance and max-width: 22ch.
Added tokens for 6 colours, 2 fonts, a 4/8/12/16/24 spacing scale and a radius, and replaced the 8 white alpha values with them.
Replaced the purple-to-cyan gradient with a calm ground and used the brand purple #6E4CF5 only on the primary action.
Removed both <hr> dividers and every border, so spacing alone now separates text, the code block and the actions.
Replaced low-opacity white-on-gradient text with solid ink (17:1) and ink-soft (8.6:1); white on the accent is 5.8:1.
Nested elements no longer try to sit concentric with the card corners; they now take small radii from the spacing scale.
Turned on tabular-nums in the code block, which holds the '3 relevant' count.
